name: ng-base-starter
description: Angular 22 starter (SSR, Tailwind 4, @lenne.tech/ng-base) for lenne.Tech projects, scaffolded by the lt CLI (lt frontend angular / lt fullstack init --frontend angular).
author: lenne.Tech GmbH

scripts.check:release: cross-env LT_RELEASE=true pnpm run check && pnpm run check:baseline
scripts.check:raw: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm audit && node scripts/check-suppressions.mjs && node scripts/check-overrides.mjs && node scripts/check-ng-base-pin.mjs && pnpm peers check && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm test && pnpm run build:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:tests && cross-env NG_OUTPUT_DIR=.output-check node scripts/check-server-start.mjs
scripts.check:fix: pnpm install && pnpm audit --fix && node scripts/check-suppressions.mjs && node scripts/check-overrides.mjs && node scripts/check-ng-base-pin.mjs && pnpm peers check && pnpm run format && pnpm run lint:fix && pnpm test && pnpm run build:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:tests && cross-env NG_OUTPUT_DIR=.output-check node scripts/check-server-start.mjs
scripts.check:naf: pnpm install && node scripts/check-suppressions.mjs && node scripts/check-overrides.mjs && node scripts/check-ng-base-pin.mjs && pnpm peers check && pnpm run format && pnpm run lint:fix && pnpm test && pnpm run build:check && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:tests && cross-env NG_OUTPUT_DIR=.output-check node scripts/check-server-start.mjs
scripts.reinit: npx rimraf pnpm-lock.yaml .angular .output .output-check .output-test node_modules && pnpm install
scripts.test:all: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.lint: oxlint --type-aware src/ scripts/ tests/ && eslint src
scripts.lint:fix: oxlint --type-aware --fix src/ scripts/ tests/ && eslint --fix src
scripts.fix: pnpm run lint:fix && pnpm run format
